THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Grilled Cheese + Protein Tomato Soup

Two Sola grilled cheeses and a creamy cottage-cheese tomato soup — about 600 calories and 49g protein for both sandwiches plus one soup serving.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIMEGriddle / skillet until golden (package has no minute count)
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~600 cal | ~49g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 2 cups Rao’s Homemade Marinara
  • 2 cups 2% cottage cheese (Good Culture used in the package)
  • 2 cups chicken bone broth (Kirkland used in the package)
  • Salt and black pepper, to taste

Ingredients — continued

  • 16 slices Sola Sweet & Buttery bread
  • 4 tbsp butter (½ tbsp per sandwich)
  • 8 slices Velveeta Original
  • 8 slices Sargento Ultra Thin provolone

Allergens: dairy, gluten.

You want a high-protein grilled cheese and tomato soup dinner without cooking meat, with a creator estimate of about 600 calories and 49g protein for the Sola version.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND. Blend the cottage cheese with enough of the measured broth until completely smooth. Stir together with the marinara and remaining broth; alternatively, blend all three together.
  2. 2.WARM SOUP. Warm gently over low heat, stirring. Avoid a vigorous boil to help keep the texture smooth. Season to taste. Divide the finished soup into 4 equal portions (roughly 1½ cups each before evaporation).
  3. 3.ASSEMBLE SANDWICHES. Spread the measured butter over the outside of the sandwich bread. Add the Velveeta and thin provolone inside.
  4. 4.COOK. Cook on a griddle or skillet over medium-low heat until golden on both sides and the cheese melts. Flip carefully; cover briefly if needed to melt the centers.
  5. 5.SERVE. Plate two Sola grilled cheeses with one soup serving and dunk. Kids filmed with brioche-bun grilled cheese are a separate plate, not the adult macro claim.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid: Serve the kid portion as described above.

If something fails

The soup looks grainy or separates: Warm gently and avoid a vigorous boil after the cottage cheese is in. Blend the cottage cheese completely smooth with broth first.

The cheese is not melting before the bread darkens: Cook medium-low and cover briefly to trap steam for the center melt.

My calories do not match ~600: The published estimate is for TWO Sola Sweet & Buttery sandwiches + ¼ soup batch, including 1 tbsp butter. Other breads (sourdough, keto, brioche) have different labels; Sola slice labels also vary (~30–40 cal).

Estimated nutrition

~600 cal | ~49g protein per 2 Sola grilled cheeses + 1 soup serving (¼ batch).

Creator-supplied working estimate from package MACRO_CHECK.md / CAPTION.md: about 600 calories and 49g protein for TWO Sola grilled cheeses + ONE soup serving (¼ of the finished batch), including 1 tbsp butter total across both sandwiches. Component math in the package: soup batch 850 cal / 82g protein → ¼ = 212.5 / 20.5; two sandwiches ≈390 / 28 using recalled 35-cal Sola slices → central 602.5 / 48.5 rounded to about 600 / 49. Bread-label range roughly 580–620 calories with ~49g protein (current Sola site image 30 cal/4gP; older listings 40 cal/4gP). Soup alone ≈213 cal / 20.5g protein per serving. No precise fat/carb claim is published because bread formulation and fiber differ. Filmed mixed-bread dinner and kids brioche-bun plates are NOT this macro basis. Soup uses chicken bone broth — do not label vegetarian. Estimate has not been independently re-verified against every current retail label; use your packages when logging.
